title: Prophecy
description: Minos, the king of Crete, makes a deal with Poseidon, granting Minos immortality so long as he fathers an heir. After his wife, Pas, gives birth to twins, Minos realizes his own prophecy is now a problem.
quote: Oh, yes, yes. Very f**king vero.
alt1: Poseidonm, with his feet up on a desk, points finger guns at Minos
alt3: in a nursery, Pas kneels to speak with her baby twins; Minos stands nearby
alt4: Minos hands his baby son over to Daedalus
